answer_1.quote: Generating rationales (or explanations) along with answers is a viable approach... We consider alternative formats of rationales, which vary according to well-defined characteristics...

answer_2.quote: We first evaluate the effectiveness of feedback through edit accuracy (edit_acc), where we manually label each revised rationale for whether it incorporates the feedback. Next, we compute final answer accuracy (final_acc), where we check whether the final answer using the revised rationale is correct.

answer_4.quote: We then perform two user studies where we measure i) the effectiveness of user feedback in patching rationales in different formats and ii) the ability of different formats to enable users to understand and trust responses... We recruit participants through Prolific... For each rationale format, annotators are asked to write natural language feedback...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate sufficiency and faithfulness of rationales on Likert scales; provide natural language feedback; rate ease of repair; and in Study 2, rate interpretability, trustworthiness, and importance of rationale properties.
